zh: 每次删除都是两个不同种类各一个，真正卡住你的只有数量最多的那一种；另外每次删 2 个，剩余个数的奇偶性始终和 n 相同。
设最多的种类出现 f 次：如果 f 超过一半，其余 n−f 个水果最多各抵消它一个；否则总能一直配对下去，最后只剩由奇偶决定的 0 或 1 个。
统计每个种类的出现次数，取最大值 f，输出 max(2f−n, n mod 2)。
en: Every removal takes one fruit from each of two different kinds, so the only real obstacle is the most frequent kind; also, each step removes 2 fruits, so the number left always has the same parity as n.

Let the most frequent kind appear f times. If f is more than half, the other n−f fruits can each cancel at most one of it; otherwise you can keep pairing until parity alone decides whether 0 or 1 remains.
Count the occurrences of each kind, take the maximum f, and print max(2f−n, n mod 2).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let f be the maximum frequency. The answer is max(2f−n, n mod 2).

## Proof of correctness

If the most frequent kind is a majority, each of the other n−f fruits can cancel at most one fruit of that kind, so 2f−n must remain, and this is achievable. Otherwise, repeatedly pair the two currently most frequent kinds; this never creates a majority too large to keep pairing, so in the end only parity matters and 0 or 1 fruit remains.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
